library_preparation_preflight.summary: com.sun.xml.ws:rt:4.0.5 is the core JAX-WS RI runtime module; its parent POM inherits jakarta.xml.ws-api/jaxb-api/soap-api/activation-api/annotation-api as real (non-managed) dependencies, so a plain testImplementation on rt resolves everything needed, mirroring the already-supported sibling jaxws-rt which required no extra setup. No Docker service or special env/system properties apply.
risks: rt excludes FastInfoset and jakarta.servlet-api (both optional/provided in its POM), unlike jaxws-rt where FastInfoset is a plain compile dependency — if generated tests end up exercising FastInfoset-backed encoding or servlet-based endpoint deployment, a testImplementation on com.sun.xml.fastinfoset:FastInfoset or jakarta.servlet:jakarta.servlet-api may be needed; verify via local Gradle test run.

com.sun.xml.ws:rt is a distinct artifact from the already-supported com.sun.xml.ws:jaxws-rt (added in PR #9978) — same upstream project (metro-jax-ws) and overlapping core classes (e.g. DatabindingFactory, SOAPVersion), so review may want to confirm this isn't an unintended duplicate request before adding full new-library metadata.
